# Omni AI

> Autonomous AI systems that generate leads, run operations, and scale businesses 24/7. Built for entrepreneurs and agencies who want AI-powered growth without micromanagement.

## Main Pages
- [Homepage](https://omnileadsagi.com): Overview of Omni AI's autonomous lead generation and business automation platform.
- [Campaigns](https://omnileadsagi.com/campaigns): AI-generated video marketing with automated testing, ranking, and optimization.
- [Infographic](https://omnileadsagi.com/details): Visual breakdown of Omni AI's features and capabilities.
- [AI Arena](https://omnileadsagi.com/arena): Competitive AI agent arena for testing and benchmarking AI performance.
- [Interlinked](https://omnileadsagi.com/interlinked): Free training on building an AI CEO system for your business. Live webinar registration.

## Products & Services
- [AI Lead Generation](https://omnileadsagi.com): Autonomous agents that find, qualify, and convert high-value leads.
- [AI Video Marketing](https://omnileadsagi.com/campaigns): AI scripts, produces, and edits marketing videos. Auto-tests and scales winners.
- [Business Automation](https://omnileadsagi.com): AI-powered operations management with memory, decision logic, and self-improvement.

## Newsletter
- [Interlinked Newsletter](https://omnileadsagi.com/newsletter): Free and premium AI strategy newsletters covering lead generation, automation, and business scaling.
